project_title: MegaRadio TV & Desktop Web Shell - Horizontal Scroll Carousel Arrow Blueprint
design_philosophy: Netflix/Prime/AppleTV inspired TV-first and Desktop-friendly horizontal carousel navigation. Focus on subtle, semi-transparent edge-cue directional arrows (left/right) for scrollable rows while preserving exact D-Pad focus mechanics and strict header layout alignment.

layout_preservation_rules.turkiye_capsule_heart_alignment: Preserve existing RADIO_PLAYER_RIGHT=1841.002 stage px. Capsule outer right and favorite frame outer right match; right inset=78.998. NOT text edge.
layout_preservation_rules.sidebar_alignment: Sidebar fixed at left48px width120px; content starts236px stage or74px relative to Discover content.
layout_preservation_rules.resolution_scale: Canonical 1920x1080 stage scaled dynamically for desktop and TV viewports via main.tsx scaler.

visual_geometry.arrow_size: 48px x 48px circular pill or 40px x 80px vertical edge bar
visual_geometry.positioning: Absolute vertical center of scroll container (top: 50%, transform: translateY(-50%))

idle_state.transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease

dpad_remote_mode.dpad_behavior_explanation: Arrows serve as visual directional edge-cues for TV users while D-pad focus navigates directly from card to card. When card focus moves near the right/left boundary, auto-scroll triggers seamlessly without breaking D-pad focus flow.

boundary_behavior.left_boundary: When container.scrollLeft <= 5px, Left Arrow is hidden (opacity: 0, pointer-events: none).
boundary_behavior.right_boundary: When container.scrollLeft + container.clientWidth >= container.scrollWidth - 5px, Right Arrow is hidden (opacity: 0, pointer-events: none).
boundary_behavior.scroll_step: Clicking arrow scrolls container by 600px (approx 3-4 card widths) smoothly (behavior: 'smooth').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a reusable shared helper/component 'HorizontalScrollArrowCue' that attaches to scroll refs (similarScrollRef, popularScrollRef, recentScrollRef, forYouScrollRef, genreScrollRef).
Listen to scroll events on horizontal rows to update showLeft / showRight state dynamically based on boundary threshold (scrollLeft > 5 and scrollLeft < scrollWidth - clientWidth - 5).
Ensure arrows have data-testid='carousel-scroll-arrow-left' and data-testid='carousel-scroll-arrow-right' for test automation.
Do NOT alter the Türkiye capsule or favorite heart button geometry or positioning on RadioPlaying or Discover screens.
Do NOT steal D-pad focus from cards to arrows on TV remote input; keep cards as primary focus items while arrows provide pointer functionality and visual indication.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default scrollbars.
Maintain high visual contrast for TV 10-foot readability.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Ensure smooth transition effects (transition-all duration-200) without transition: all on universal wrappers.
